discovery_notes: Django 1.11.29 + SQLite served via Python 3.7 dev server on port 8000. The build context is the server/ subdirectory (not the repo root) — pass workspaceDir=<repo_root>/server to build_and_start_app_server. The repo also has a React frontend in web/ (Create React App) that copies its build into server/static/build/, but the Docker image omits it since the API endpoints work independently. No external services or secrets required.
